title: RossFast head-space temporal certificate feasibility and bounded qualification

canonical_at_start.head: 52d66ba612096184327f58a076ef22bd0119e237
canonical_at_start.model_certificate_contract: available AND finite AND indicator >= 0 AND indicator <= 1

scientific_motivation.d3g02_failure: theta-space raw full-vs-two-half estimator was not uniformly conservative under the precommitted factor-1 rule
scientific_motivation.diagnosis: all observed ratio>1 cases occur at normalized theta errors below 5e-16, i.e. at floating-point/reference-resolution scale; the worst O01 attempt-1 case had raw=1.9499655480887093e-16 and refined reference error=3.119944876941935e-16
scientific_motivation.new_hypothesis: pressure-head space may preserve temporal separation when theta-space differences collapse to numerical resolution, while using the same RossFast candidate lineage and no new solver trajectory

stage_b1_feasibility.purpose: test the head-space hypothesis only; B1 cannot close G02 and cannot publish a runtime certificate
stage_b1_feasibility.coarse_path: one RossFast candidate with 8 equal internal substeps over the full attempt duration
stage_b1_feasibility.refined_path: two chained RossFast candidates with 8 equal internal substeps per half duration
stage_b1_feasibility.reference: the same independent DOP853 theta trajectory used by D3G02, converted to pressure head through the frozen RossFast constitutive mapping
pass_rule: all 54 candidate chains ready and candidate-only
all head quantities finite and inside the frozen RossFast table envelope
for every case with independently resolvable head error: refined_reference_head_error_cm <= raw_head_estimator_cm
no posthoc multiplicative safety factor may be introduced to turn a failing B1 into PASS
stage_b1_feasibility.resolution_rule: A case is not declared a conservativity violation when the alleged violation is smaller than or equal to the independently observed reference self-head delta; such a case is classified UNRESOLVED_AT_REFERENCE_PRECISION, not PASS. B1 overall PASS requires zero resolved violations; unresolved cases must be reported separately and cannot themselves establish conservativity.

stage_b2_qualification_if_b1_passes.authorization: conditional only; do not execute if B1 has a resolved nonconservativity failure
minimum_expansion: nominal plus frozen D2/D3R bounded forcing perturbation coverage
D3R duration ladder attempts 0..8 plus half-duration 1..9 coverage
hard mass gate independent from temporal gate
fail-closed request outside qualified material/duration/forcing envelope
stage_b2_qualification_if_b1_passes.budget_semantics: H_budget_cm must be explicit caller-supplied numerical/application accuracy configuration; no universal, coupling, application or production default is selected by D3G02B.
stage_b2_qualification_if_b1_passes.candidate_indicator: B_h_cm / H_budget_cm where B_h_cm is a separately qualified conservative head-space temporal bound
